Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes — damaged or defective items are handled differently from a normal return. Regular returns/exchanges aren’t accepted because Bellesa products are final sale, but if an item arrived damaged or has a product flaw, we can review it through our damage/defect process. Was the damage caused during shipping, or is it an issue with the product itself?
